caption:
New office, new desk every morning. By Friday, Mr Turtle's back is feeling it.

Give yourself two minutes when you sit down. Chair first: feet flat, hips level with or slightly above your knees, back against the backrest. Then the screen: an arm's length away with the top near eye level. Pull the keyboard and mouse close so your elbows rest by your sides.

A compact laptop stand and a lumbar cushion in your bag make any desk easier, and getting up regularly still matters most.

Pain spreading into an arm or leg, pins and needles or numbness are worth getting checked. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
